newsitem.title: CROATIA: Podravka steals show in dull Croatian market.
newsitem.headline: Podravka steals show in dull Croatian market.

text.p: Croatian food processor Podravka took the spotlight again in slow stock market trade on Friday, as the summer lull approached, traders said.

"Neither the London bourse-listed Pliva or Zagrebacka Banka traded on Friday. Both are having problems finding buyers on the London stock market and this may result in the fall in stock prices," an analyst told Reuters.
Podravka sold 2,617 shares to close 2.4 percent higher at 256.1 kuna.
"The latest rise in the price of Podravka shares is a direct result of the 60 million german mark loan at 2.50 percent over Libor it got on Wednesday," the analyst said.
Out of 13 issues that traded, two rose, nine fell and two were flat. Volume totalling 3,759 was a fifth less than Thursday and turnover was 1.5 million kuna, down from 2.4 million.
The other gainer apart from Podravka was Zagrebacka Banka C-series stock which added five kuna to its stock ending the day at 885 kuna on volume of just 21 shares.
Istraturist, the biggest decliner, lost 13 kuna or 7.3 percent to 165.00 with 203 shares sold.

"It does not seem that anything exciting will be happening on the stock market in the coming few weeks, as buyers are saving themselves for September which will bring a fresh impetus to the market," the analyst said.
